findings.body: The new tests cover `CVV 811`, but `Card number: 811` is new evidence of the same unsafe-digit gap. Neither `card` nor `number` appears in this list, so the helper removes the standalone `811` before checking for three digits and returns the variant as valid. An explicit card-detail variant must be refused. Restrict the product-number exception to product-name contexts and test this case.
findings.title: Not done: Refuse card-number variants with 811
